note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; plain relations carry no arrowhead and causal arrows appear only when the author supplies a causal relation. No doctrine on packing, sealing, tampering or custody and no outcome is drawn. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit.
